title: group_select silently sets current_group=None on invalid GroupName, still returns 211
description: reader/src/session/commands/group.rs:37: ctx.current_group = GroupName::new(gd.name.clone()).ok(). If GroupName validation fails, .ok() returns None. Lines 38-40 then set state=GroupSelected and return 211. The client is told the group was selected, but ctx.current_group is None. Any subsequent command that reads ctx.current_group (OVER, ARTICLE <number>, NEXT, LAST) will get None and behave as if no group is selected — returning 412 instead of the expected result. The session is in an inconsistent state that appears as a 211 success. In practice this only fires if the group cache contains an invalid group name. Fix: treat GroupName::new failure as an internal error (tracing::error + return 503) rather than silently setting None.
